{{Quote|You bring yourself honor, outsider.|Cavrus-Til|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Cavrus-Til''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was among the few of his people who left their homeworld to see the larger galaxy. Cavrus-Til eventually settled on the galactic capitol of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where around [[3640 BBY]] he was delivered a package from his home by the [[Voidhound]].
